run_download_eth3d_dataset: run the python script to download and extract the ETH3D dataset to a target directory
run_download_file_with_progress: run the download_file function to download a URL to a local file with a tqdm progress bar
create_download_with_progress_bar: create a function that downloads a file from a URL with streaming and a tqdm progress bar
extract_7z_archive: extract a 7z archive file to a target directory using py7zr and remove the archive
refactor_download_file: refactor the download_file function to support resumable downloads or authentication headers
